document.title: Pages: a merged pull request's review and screenshots stay up for 30 days
document.summary: Closing a pull request no longer deletes its hosted review; only the 30-day prune does.
document.why: [PR #205](source:s1) says a closed pull request's hosted review and screenshots were deleted within a minute, breaking the links in merged PR descriptions.

sources.label: PR #205
sources.title: Pages: a merged pull request's review and screenshots stay up for 30 days

groups.title: Stop pruning on close
groups.summary: The `Pages reviews` workflow drops its `pull_request: closed` trigger and `prune --pr` step, and the index page, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and two test titles stop promising deletion on close.

attention.note: With no close trigger, the daily 04:23 UTC run of `prune --ttl-days 30 --keep presentation` is the only automatic removal, and `matchesPrune` ages a site from its `publishedAt`. So a pull request closed unmerged, or abandoned, also keeps its public review and screenshots on `gh-pages` for up to 30 days after its last publish. Decide whether that is acceptable for every closed pull request, not only merged ones.

notes.body: The removed `if` guard is moot: only `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` start the job now.

fileNotes..github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml: Closing a pull request no longer starts a run.
fileNotes.CONTRIBUTING.md: Says sites go 30 days after last publish, not on close.
fileNotes.scripts/pages-review.test.ts: Titles only; the `prune --pr` assertions are unchanged.
fileNotes.scripts/pages-review.ts: `pagesIndexHtml` drops the close sentence; no test asserts that copy.
